scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:examples && npm run prepare:ocr && vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @caseattend/core && tsc --noEmit --pretty false && npm run check --workspace @caseattend/react && npm run check --workspace @caseattend/example-basic && npm run check --workspace @caseattend/example-self-hosted-research
scripts.check:sdk: npm run build --workspace @caseattend/core && npm run check --workspace @caseattend/react && npm run check --workspace @caseattend/example-basic && npm run check --workspace @caseattend/example-self-hosted-research
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build --workspace @caseattend/core && npm run build --workspace @caseattend/react
scripts.build:examples: npm run build --workspace @caseattend/example-basic && npm run build --workspace @caseattend/example-self-hosted-research
scripts.pack:sdk: npm run build:sdk && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @caseattend/core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @caseattend/react
